mapping_note: This is one direct witness for saved federation information remaining restorable after destruction and recreation. It checks a saved explicit two-member synchronization point through public callbacks and subsequent public achievement; it does not claim complete save-image coverage or persistence across an RTI-process restart.
notes: The portable C++ TCK uses only the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 API and standard library. It completes a federation save, destroys the execution, recreates it, rejoins the same two-member set with new joined-federate identities, restores the saved execution, and completes the saved synchronization point. Adapter/provider portability and full HLA conformance are not established by this local Umbra run.
